row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; site shows Join Waitlist)
row.evidence: Pocus's User Management doc says 'Okta SCIM is supported for enterprise customers to manage the addition and removal of users.'
row.notes: Quote-only: Pocus publishes no plans or prices (www.pocus.com/pricing redirects to the home page, which offers only 'Join Waitlist'), and its docs limit SCIM to enterprise customers. Pocus announced it is joining Apollo; the announcement says nothing changes in the platform for now, so the row stays under Pocus. Only Okta SCIM is documented: an admin adds a provisioning connection, picks Okta as the directory provider, and pastes the provisioning URL and token into a custom Okta app (no Okta OIN listing found). SAML SSO (Okta) and Google SSO need Pocus support to enable; Okta groups can map to Pocus roles at SSO sign-in. No public user-management API.

plans.name: Enterprise (quote-only)
plans.notes: No public tier table; the home page offers only a waitlist.

scim.notes: Base URL is a per-connection provisioning URL shown in Pocus Workspace Settings; the docs do not state the SCIM version.

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > User Management > Provisioning > Add New (Okta) - copy provisioning URL and authorization token

operations.notes: Docs say SCIM manages 'the addition and removal of users' (whether removal deactivates or deletes is not stated) and to enable every supported Okta action except Import groups; the individual actions are not listed.

deprovision.notes: SCIM handles removal of users; deactivate vs delete is not documented.

roles.how: Okta group-to-role mapping is documented for SAML SSO sign-in, not for SCIM.

limitations.text: Only Okta is documented as a SCIM directory provider; Okta 'Import groups' should not be enabled.

user_api.notes: Pocus's public docs (llms.txt index) have no API reference; users are invited and removed in Workspace Settings.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs exist in the User Management settings; no API is documented.

okta.notes: Set up as a custom SAML app with SCIM provisioning per Pocus docs; okta.com/integrations/pocus/ returned 404, so no OIN listing was found.

fallbacks.notes: Okta SSO with a claimed domain authenticates all domain users and assigns a default role (JIT). Pocus will set up teams from a CSV on request.
